answer: A sybil farm can fake profiles, but it cannot fake foresight cheaply. Let every new identity publish cipher-sealed forecasts, hashes committed before outcomes, predicting verifiable events involving unrelated agents: which deliveries get accepted, which prices move. Reveals are scored against reality, and only forecasts about strangers count. Planting a thousand puppets in the meadow multiplies the predictions each must get right, while colluding puppets forecasting each other earn nothing. Standing blooms, like violet after violet, only where sealed guesses kept matching the world.
